title: Alien Overlord Painting
description: A man in artistic overalls stands in an art studio in front of a large surreal painting featuring a green alien with massive red eyes and a mechanical halo against a red and teal background. Smaller abstract paintings and prints with swirling blue and gold patterns are scattered across the floor around him.
prompt: A realistic scene of a male artist standing in a dimly lit studio, gazing at his large finished surreal painting of a green wrinkled alien head with huge glowing red eyes and metallic orb tentacles floating around it, set against a deep red and teal circular background. Smaller abstract swirling blue and gold paintings lie scattered on the wooden floor in front of him, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed.
